captions.detailed: A drill-press vise consisting of a flat rectangular dark gray base plate with two parallel guide rails. A low, fixed rear jaw is mounted at one end of the base, while a movable front jaw slides linearly along the guide ways. A handwheel with spokes is mounted on the side, connected to a horizontal screw axis that drives the prismatic sliding motion of the front jaw.
captions.instruction: Generate a dark gray drill-press vise with a flat rectangular base, a fixed rear jaw, and a sliding front jaw. Include a side-mounted handwheel that rotates continuously to drive the prismatic sliding motion of the front jaw along the base guide ways.
captions.factory: Construct the base part using a flat rectangular Box primitive and add two parallel guide rails. Build the fixed jaw as a rectangular block on one end of the base. Model the moving jaw as a separate part that translates prismatically along the guide rails. Create the handwheel using a cylinder and spokes, attaching it via a continuous rotational joint to simulate the screw drive mechanism.
